Render a rich UI inline in the chat using shadcn-styled components. By default, pass a
single JSON object as the spec argument. The UI renders, and becomes interactive, once
the tool call completes.

WHEN TO USE:
- Reach for UI as part of a normal answer whenever it reads better than prose: a metric
  row (Stat), a trend or comparison (Chart), options side by side (Grid of Cards), a
  structured result (Table), a status (Progress/Badge), or a question with explicit
  choices (OptionList/ApprovalCard + submit). Keep the prose short and let the UI carry
  the data; do not repeat the same numbers in markdown.
- Small live tools (budget or loan calculators, converters, estimators) work here too:
  bind inputs to state and derive results with $computed (see COMPUTED VALUES).
- Widget state is saved: checkbox ticks, typed values, and setState/pushState changes
  are restored when the user reopens the chat, and a submitted widget stays submitted.
  So a checklist, tracker, or plan the user works through over time belongs here; keep
  everything the user changes in "state" (bound inputs and state actions).
- Call ui.get_state to read what the user has done with widgets in this conversation
  (for example before answering "what's left on my list?") instead of assuming the
  initial state you rendered is still current.
- For anything this catalog can't express (custom visualizations such as treemaps,
  heatmaps or diagrams, canvas drawings, games, or a mock of a product screen), use
  artifact.render with kind "html" instead. It renders a sandboxed page at full width
  in the chat with the app's theme tokens available.

FORMAT SELECTION:
- Omit format, or set format to "json-render", for the native Ryu spec below.
- Set format to "a2ui" to pass one A2UI v0.9/v0.9.1 envelope, a JSONL stream, an
  array of JSON messages, or { "messages": [...] }. Ryu accepts the A2UI createSurface,
  updateComponents, updateDataModel, and deleteSurface messages and maps the known
  basic catalog components into the same closed Ryu catalog. Unsupported components
  render as inert notices; functionCall expressions and actions are never executed.
  A2UI surfaces are rendered one surface per card.

SPEC SHAPE (flat element tree):
{
  "root": "<rootKey>",
  "elements": {
    "<key>": { "type": "<Component>", "props": { ... }, "children": ["<childKey>", ...] },
    ...
  },
  "state": { ... optional initial state ... }
}
- "root" names the top element key. "elements" is a flat map keyed by string id.
- "children" is an array of element KEYS (references into "elements"), not nested objects.
- Only use component types from AVAILABLE COMPONENTS below.

DYNAMIC DATA & BINDING (optional):
- Read state into a prop: { "$state": "/path/to/value" } (RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, leading slash).
- Two-way bind an input: set its value/checked prop to { "$bindState": "/form/email" }.
- Repeat children over a state array: add a top-level "repeat" on an element —
  { "type": "Stack", "props": {}, "repeat": { "statePath": "/items", "key": "id" }, "children": ["row"] }.
  Inside repeated children read fields with { "$item": "field" } and the index with { "$index": true }.
- Seed any referenced state in the "state" object (e.g. "state": { "items": [...], "form": { "email": "" } }).

ACTIONS (optional):
- Buttons emit a "press" event; wire it via the element's "on" field:
  { "type": "Button", "props": { "label": "Add" }, "on": { "press": { "action": "pushState",
    "params": { "statePath": "/items", "value": { "id": "$id", "title": { "$state": "/draft" } } } } } }
- Built-in actions: setState { statePath, value }, pushState { statePath, value }, removeState { statePath, index }.
- Show or hide an element with a top-level "visible" field (sibling of type/props), e.g.
  "visible": { "$state": "/tab", "eq": "details" }.

COMPUTED VALUES (optional):
- Derive a prop from state with { "$computed": "<function>", "args": { ... } }. Args may be
  literals, { "$state": ... } reads, or nested $computed expressions. Functions are pure
  and return null (format: "—") on missing or non-numeric input, so half-filled forms are safe.
- Interpolate text with { "$template": "Total: ${/cart/total}" }.
- Example (monthly loan payment shown as currency, live as the user types):
  "value": { "$computed": "format", "args": { "style": "currency", "value":
    { "$computed": "payment", "args": { "principal": { "$state": "/loan/amount" },
      "rate": { "$computed": "divide", "args": { "a": { "$state": "/loan/apr" }, "b": 1200 } },
      "periods": { "$computed": "multiply", "args": { "a": { "$state": "/loan/years" }, "b": 12 } } } } } }
- Available functions:
  - add: a + b
  - subtract: a - b
  - multiply: a * b
  - divide: a / b (null when b is 0)
  - percent: part / total as a fraction (format with style 'percent')
  - sum: Sum of `values` (an array of numbers, or of objects read at `field`)
  - average: Mean of `values` (optionally read at `field`)
  - min: Smallest of `values` (optionally read at `field`)
  - max: Largest of `values` (optionally read at `field`)
  - count: Number of entries in `values`
  - round: Round `value` to `digits` decimal places (default 0)
  - clamp: Limit `value` to the range [`min`, `max`]
  - payment: Loan payment per period: `principal`, per-period `rate` (0.005 = 0.5%), `periods`
  - format: Format `value` for display: `style` number|currency|percent|compact, optional `digits`, `currency` (ISO code, default USD)

CHARTS & METRICS:
- Chart: { "type": "bar"|"line"|"area"|"pie", "xKey": "month", "data": [{ "month": "Jan", "revenue": 120 }],
  "series": [{ "key": "revenue", "label": "Revenue" }], "valueFormat": "currency" }. Colors come from the
  app theme; at most 5 series and 500 rows. Pie uses series[0] as the value and xKey as the slice name.
- Stat: { "label": "MRR", "value": "$42.1k", "delta": "+8% MoM", "trend": "up" }. Put 2-4 in a Grid.

EXAMPLE spec:
{
  "root": "card",
  "elements": {
    "card": { "type": "Card", "props": { "title": "Deploy status" }, "children": ["body"] },
    "body": { "type": "Stack", "props": { "gap": "sm" }, "children": ["msg", "bar"] },
    "msg": { "type": "Text", "props": { "text": "Building…", "muted": true }, "children": [] },
    "bar": { "type": "Progress", "props": { "value": 60 }, "children": [] }
  }
}

Prefer this tool over ASCII tables or long markdown when showing structured data,
forms, metrics, charts, or status. Keep specs focused; one coherent UI per call.

RYU APP UI RULES:
- Every Companion entrypoint must mount its app inside RyuAppShell from
  @ryu/blocks/companion/app-ui. The v1 label is the stable contract version, not an indication
  that an app may ship a partial implementation.
- For Companion or app-like surfaces, use the fixed Ryu App UI vocabulary: shell, toolbar, main,
  section, list, list section, list item, detail, form, field, empty, and actions.
- Use Ryu semantic tokens and the shared @ryu/ui primitives. Do not invent a new button, card,
  input, radius, shadow, or typography system for one app.
- Every async app surface needs an intentional loading, empty, error, and disabled state where it
  applies. Domain-specific graphs, canvases, and editors may stay specialized, but their generic
  chrome and controls stay Ryu-native.

AVAILABLE COMPONENTS (26):
- Stack: { direction?: "row" | "column", gap?: "none" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl", align?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "stretch", justify?: "start" | "center" | "end" | "between" | "around", wrap?: boolean } - Vertical or horizontal flex container. The primary layout primitive. [accepts children]
- Grid: { columns?: number, gap?: "none" | "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "xl" } - Responsive equal-column grid. [accepts children]
- Card: { title?: string, description?: string } - Bordered surface with an optional title/description header. Group related content. [accepts children]
- Separator: { orientation?: "horizontal" | "vertical" } - A thin dividing line.
- Heading: { text: string, level?: number } - A section heading.
- Text: { text: string, muted?: boolean, size?: "xs" | "sm" | "base" | "lg", weight?: "normal" | "medium" | "semibold" | "bold" } - A paragraph or inline run of text.
- Link: { text: string, href: string } - A hyperlink. Opens in a new tab.
- Image: { src: string, alt?: string, rounded?: boolean } - An image.
- Avatar: { src?: string, alt?: string, fallback?: string } - A circular user/avatar image with initials fallback.
- Badge: { text: string, variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "outline" | "destructive" } - A small status/label pill.
- Alert: { title?: string, description?: string, variant?: "default" | "destructive" } - A callout box for important information or errors.
- Table: { columns: Array<string>, rows: Array<Array<string>> } - A simple data table from columns + rows.
- Chart: { type: "bar" | "line" | "area" | "pie", data: Array<Record<string, string | number | unknown>>, xKey: string, series: Array<{ key: string, label?: string, color?: "chart-1" | "chart-2" | "chart-3" | "chart-4" | "chart-5" }>, stacked?: boolean, height?: number, valueFormat?: "number" | "compact" | "percent" | "currency", currency?: string, showLegend?: boolean } - A themed bar, line, area, or pie chart with tooltips. Use for trends, comparisons, and shares instead of a table of numbers.
- Stat: { label: string, value: string | number, delta?: string, trend?: "up" | "down" | "neutral", description?: string } - A KPI tile: label, large value, optional delta. Put several in a Grid for a metric row.
- Progress: { value: number, label?: string } - A horizontal progress bar.
- Skeleton: { width?: string, height?: string } - A loading placeholder block.
- Button: { label: string, variant?: "default" | "secondary" | "outline" | "ghost" | "destructive" | "link", size?: "sm" | "default" | "lg", disabled?: boolean } - A clickable button. Attach an action with the element's `on.press` to mutate state (e.g. { action: 'setState', params: { statePath: '/path', value } }).
- Input: { placeholder?: string, value?: string, label?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" } - A single-line text field. Two-way bind `value` to state via { $bindState: 'form.field' }.
- Textarea: { placeholder?: string, value?: string, label?: string, rows?: number } - A multi-line text field. Two-way bind `value` to state.
- Checkbox: { label?: string, checked?: boolean } - A boolean checkbox. Two-way bind `checked` to state.
- Switch: { label?: string, checked?: boolean } - A boolean toggle switch. Two-way bind `checked` to state.
- Select: { placeholder?: string, value?: string, options: Array<{ label: string, value: string, description?: string }> } - A dropdown select. Provide `options` as { label, value }[] and two-way bind `value` to state.
- OptionList: { label?: string, value?: string, options: Array<{ label: string, value: string, description?: string }> } - An accessible single-choice list. Two-way bind `value` to state and use for a small set of explicit choices.
- Slider: { label?: string, value?: number, min?: number, max?: number, step?: number } - A bounded numeric slider. Two-way bind `value` to state; defaults to 0-100 with step 1.
- ApprovalCard: { title: string, description?: string, approveLabel?: string, rejectLabel?: string } - A compact approval decision card. Wire `approve` and `reject` events to actions in the element's `on` field.
- LinkPreview: { title: string, href: string, description?: string, imageSrc?: string } - A safe link preview card. HTTP(S) and mailto URLs are allowed; unsafe schemes render inertly.
